heroHeadline: Netanyahu Cabinet Weighs Imminent War Resumption as Board of Peace Removes Diplomatic Shield; Investigation Deadline 54 Days Away — Day 943
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 7, 2026 (Day 943 / Ceasefire Day 210), Israel's security cabinet continued deliberations on whether to issue a formal war resumption order in Gaza — following the May 6 Board of Peace announcement that it will not hold Israel to ceasefire terms if Hamas rejects disarmament, effectively giving Israel a diplomatic green light. IDF operational plans for a new ground offensive are reported complete and awaiting political authorization; new IAF Commander Maj. Gen. Omer Tishler (who replaced Tomer Bar on May 5) was immediately integrated into war resumption planning. Egyptian and Qatari mediators mounted last-minute appeals to prevent resumed hostilities. Simultaneously, 54 days remain until the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 deadline for the Netanyahu government to present an October 7 investigation framework. Accountability pressure intensified following outgoing IAF Commander Tomer Bar's May 5 landmark public call for an independent external investigation, and the April 2026 IDF external panel finding that most internal October 7 probes were 'inadequate.' Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved political and accountability wound driving Israel's domestic politics. 74% of Israelis support an independent commission; Gaza phase 2 disarmament talks remain in total deadlock. Cumulative Palestinian death toll since October 7, 2023 exceeds 72,600+; 830+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire (2,400+ documented violations per Gaza GMO).
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, WAFA, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Cumulative conflict dead (Oct 7, 2023 – May 7, 2026): 72,600+ Palestinians per OCHA/Gaza MoH/WAFA. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 2025; 2,400+ violations documented by Gaza GMO — 830+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire as of May 7, 2026. May 5: Outgoing IAF Chief Tomer Bar calls for independent Oct 7 investigation; IDF Chief Zamir acknowledges IAF 'failed its mission'; Maj. Gen. Omer Tishler becomes new IAF Commander. May 6: Board of Peace won't hold Israel to truce terms if Hamas doesn't accept disarmament — IDF controls ~60% of Gaza; war resumption plans completed pending political authorization. May 7 (Day 943): Netanyahu cabinet deliberating imminent war resumption order; Egypt/Qatar last-minute mediation; 54 days to Supreme Court July 1 investigation deadline. ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant remain active. Gaza reconstruction cost: $71.4B per UN-EU-World Bank joint assessment; <$1B of $17B pledged received.
